text:
riley: Heads-up — bulk CSV import flushed ~1.2k trial accounts last night and ~420 of them have no owner_id. Playbooks didn't claim them so onboarding nudges never fired. Seeing an early activation drop for that cohort. :warning:

mia: Ugh. Do we have a quick query to surface them? can run a sample export. :eyes:

riley: Yup, ran one locally. snippet:
```sql
SELECT id, email, company_name, owner_id, imported_by, created_at
FROM accounts
WHERE imported_via = 'csv-batch-2026-03-22'
  AND owner_id IS NULL
LIMIT 200;
```
Numbers: 1,224 total imported, 420 ownerless, ~38% of that cohort are paid-convertible trials (based on plan_tier).

alex: We should backfill owners to a staging steward account and tag them so playbooks don't trigger until owners review. Proposed flow:
1) set owner_id = 'cs:steward' (internal user)
2) add tag `import:temp-owner` and `import:skip-playbook`
3) enqueue for manual claim by owners via review queue
Avoids false nudges and keeps tracking for telemetry.

jordan: Agree. Two asks: dry-run first, and schedule during low-traffic (overnight). Also we should record counts by segment (trial tier, sales region).

alex: Dry-run curl I used for testing (skip_playbooks flag):
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.app/internal/bulk-update \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}' \
  -d '{"filter":"imported_via=csv-batch-2026-03-22 AND owner_id IS NULL","set":{"owner_id":"cs:steward","tags":["import:temp-owner","import:skip-playbook"]},"dry_run":true}'
```
This returns a CSV preview and counts. No downstream webhooks fired in dry-run.

ops-bot: scheduled job created: `backfill-ownerless-csv-2026-03-23` at 02:00 UTC (window: 02:00-02:30). Trigger will run with `skip_playbooks=true` and write a audit_log id: afl-20260323-07.

sam: Small tweak: playbook automation should respect `import:skip-playbook` tag for 14 days OR until `owner_reviewed=true`. Otherwise we risk long-term suppression. Can we add that guard now?

riley: Yes — plan is 14-day suppression + review flag. After owner claims we remove `import:skip-playbook` and set `owner_reviewed=true` which will re-enable normal playbooks.

mia: I'll own post-run QA and the review queue. After the backfill, I'll sample 100 accounts across regions and confirm owners, playbook suppression set, and activation rates.

alex: One more: add telemetry event `cs.import.owner_backfill` with payload {backfilled, cohort_tag, suppressed_until, audit_log_id} so we can chart activation deltas.

riley: Perfect. Tests: dry-run now, full run at 02:00 UTC, post-run QA by @mia, and telemetry dashboard update by @alex. If numbers look good we can promote to import pipeline change (prevent future ownerless imports). :white_check_mark:

mia: Got it — will post QA summary in this thread after checks (ETA 03:30 UTC).

jordan: Thanks all. Also can we add a short runbook for CS to claim these from the review queue? saves time for oncall rotations.

riley: Adding runbook to Confluence after QA. Link will be in this thread. :link:
